data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's cross-city mechanism is empirically falsified by the well-documented 'oasis effect' and diurnal asymmetry of population-density scaling. Population density correlates strongly with the DAYTIME UHI (via reduced evapotranspiration and increased sensible heat), but it is a comparatively poor predictor of the NOCTURNAL UHI, which the question specifically asks about. The nocturnal gap is instead best predicted by urban geometry (sky view factor / street canyon trapping of longwave radiation). The target relies on an analogy (CPU under load) that only holds for active heat generation and incorrectly transfers this to nocturnal cooling dynamics.
